title: Add metadata header blocks to agent instruction files
body:
Per `.github/instructions/docs.instructions.md` § "Required Header Block for Non-Trivial Docs", durable reference docs must carry a `## Metadata` block. The four agent instruction files (the repo-wide constitution and the three per-agent entry points) lacked one.

## Description

- Added a `## Metadata` section (Status / Owner / Last Updated / Scope / Related) immediately after the existing `**Version:**` line in each of:
  - `.github/copilot-instructions.md` — scoped as the canonical repo-wide constitution; Related links to the docs style guide.
  - `CLAUDE.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `GEMINI.md` — scoped as agent-specific entry points that mirror a minimal summary of shared rules; Related links to the canonical instructions and docs style guide.
- Bumped each file's `**Version:**` per the `MAJOR.MINOR.YYYYMMDD.PATCH` scheme; date segment unchanged (`20260430`), so patch was incremented:
  - `.github/copilot-instructions.md`: `1.2.20260430.0` → `1.2.20260430.1`
  - `CLAUDE.md`: `1.4.20260430.2` → `1.4.20260430.3`
  - `AGENTS.md`: `1.2.20260430.0` → `1.2.20260430.1`
  - `GEMINI.md`: `1.2.20260430.0` → `1.2.20260430.1`
- No other content changes.

Downstream repositories that consume these files via sync will inherit the metadata blocks automatically.

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [x] Documentation update
- [ ] Dependencies update
- [ ] Configuration/tooling change

## Checklist

### General

- [ ] I have read the [contributing guidelines](../blob/HEAD/CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [x] My code follows the coding standards in `.github/instructions/`
- [x] My changes follow `.github/copilot-instructions.md` and any applicable `.github/instructions/*`
- [x] I have performed a self-review of my own code
- [ ] I have commented my code where necessary, particularly in hard-to-understand areas
- [x] I have made corresponding changes to the documentation
- [x] My changes generate no new warnings
- [ ] I have added or updated tests where appropriate
- [x] New and existing tests pass locally (where applicable)

### Pre-commit Verification (if configured)

- [x] If this repository uses pre-commit, I ran `pre-commit run --all-files` and all checks pass
- [x] If pre-commit made auto-fixes, I reviewed and committed them

### Python-Specific (if applicable)

N/A — documentation-only change.

### PowerShell-Specific (if applicable)

N/A — documentation-only change.

## Additional Notes

Verified via `markdownlint-cli2` (`npm run lint:md`): 0 errors across 25 Markdown files. Each new metadata block sits at document level (not inside a fence/quote/example) and within the first 30 lines of its file, satisfying the placement rules in `docs.instructions.md`.

## Related Issues
